_doc: Sound library of the channel. sounds — ready files assets/sound/<id>.mp3 (not in git); planned — to be generated (ElevenLabs sound effects, only on an explicit command of the owner: it costs credits). A script sound finds an entry by id or match (a regex over the name). Anything not in the library is silence. The example ships no audio files: every sound below is planned, so the mix is silent and the sounds are listed in audio/sfx_missing.md.

amb_cafe.prompt: Quiet small café room tone, a distant espresso machine hiss, soft cups, seamless loop

paper.prompt: A small paper card slid across a wooden counter

stamp.prompt: Rubber stamp pressed firmly on a paper card on a wooden counter, one thud

step_soft.prompt: One soft footstep on a wooden floor
